first.summary:
Labelled all 18 posters (r2-001 to r2-018) in festival-poster 1.0 from the original images plus zoom bands and extra crops. Every file is in data/benchmarks/gold-v2/ and prints OK on validate. All 18 are real event posters. Points that need a reviewer:
- Year missing: only r2-016 prints no 4-digit year, so its iso is null with year_basis absent. The validator warns year_absent and gives [2026] as a candidate, which I did not fill in.
- admin_area: I set it from bare city or county names printed as separate words in the title or venue (원주, 부여, 장수, 용산, 하남, 남양주, 속초, 광명). I left it absent where the name only appears inside a compound word (예산황새축제, 시흥갯골축제, 수원화성, 금산세계인삼축제), following the team's yesan example. The reviewed v2 gold files are not consistent on this, so the team should agree on one rule.
- Small logos: many sponsor and organiser logos at about 443 px wide could not be read. They are recorded as illegible items with null names, keeping their printed role labels.
- Not recorded: text that is not festival information, such as signs inside illustrations, design credits and English translations of the venue.
- QR codes: all QR codes are decode_status not_attempted.
Temporary helper and crop files are in the scratchpad folder r2lab001_018. The only repository files written are the 18 gold JSONs, plus the zoom PNGs the tool writes to .runtime/poster-ocr/zoom.

second.summary: I re-checked all 18 gold files (r2-001 to r2-018) against the original images and my own zoomed crops. No label slot needed correcting. Every file has status, raw/normalised values and evidence consistent with what is printed: titles and slogans, dates with year inheritance and year_basis, printed weekdays, times, venue splits, admin_area, organisations with role labels and logo counts, contacts, links, QR codes, programmes and performers, budget lines and badges. The only fixes were two wrong image sizes in quality.notes: r2-011 says 443×627 but the image is 445×627, and r2-013 says 443×627 but it is 444×627. In all 18 files I set extraction.extractor.version to "gold-v2/pass2-reviewed" and added one extraction.notes line starting "검토(pass2)" (r2-011 and r2-013 also record the size fix). All 18 files print OK on validate; the remaining output is only the expected info/warning findings, such as unread logos, QR codes not decoded and year_absent on r2-016. Text I re-zoomed and still could not read stays illegible or unrecorded: performer names in r2-005 other than JUNCOCO, the illegible logos in r2-002, r2-009, r2-013, r2-015 and r2-018, and the small line under r2-001's sponsor logos. I edited only the 18 assigned files; temporary crops and helper scripts are in the session scratchpad under rev_a.
